new.title: Noah Building the Ark | Beyond the Story: Noach (Ep. 2)
new.blurb: Why did Noach spend 120 years building the teivah and work around the clock feeding its animals while so much of his mission unfolded miraculously? Understanding when Hashem requires human effort and when He provides without it reveals the true relationship between hishtadlus and bitachon: our work creates a vessel, while the blessing comes entirely from Hashem. Teachings and stories from the Baal Shem Tov and other tzaddikim show why blessings come through natural channels, where our energy belongs, and how to recognize whether our trust in Hashem has reached beyond our intellect into our hearts. Rediscover the Torah stories you’ve known since childhood. In this weekly live class, Rabbi Shais Taub uncovers their deeper mystical and spiritual meaning, revealing practical lessons for our relationships, challenges, and everyday lives. PDF Material: https://www.soulwords.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Animals-Enter-Teiva_compressed.pdf

latest.title: Likkutei Sichos: Simchas Torah
latest.blurb: Shemini Atzeres reveals the essential unity of the Jewish people that endures beyond Yom Tov. Dancing with our feet and a closed Torah scroll expresses an unlimited connection to Hashem that transcends intellect. Connecting the Torah’s end, “l’einei kol Yisrael,” back to its beginning, “B’reishis bara Elokim,” demands that we reveal the G-dliness within ourselves and the world, with unconditional Ahavas Yisrael as the ultimate sign that our soul’s essence has been revealed. This class, taught by Rabbi Shais Taub, is based on Shemini Atzeres / Simchas Torah in Likkutei Sichos Vol. 2. 📄 PDF of Sicha: https://heyzine.com/flip-book/2d93343... 📄 PDF of Sicha in English by SIE: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tlaz... 📖 Buy Likkutei Sichos Vol. 2 at Kehot: https://store.kehotonline.com/prodinf...

latest.title: Likkutei Sichos: Sukkos
latest.blurb: The festival of Sukkos is named after the sukkah because it is the mitzvah that encompasses the entire person from the very start of Yom Tov, enabling us to elevate even our most ordinary activities into Divine service throughout the year. True joy comes from drawing on the infinite Source through kabbalas ol, rather than relying on our own limited capacities. The incomparable joy of Simchas Beis Hashoevah comes from transcending our usual boundaries, as even the highest human faculty—the intellect—finds its fulfillment in submitting to what lies beyond reason. The story of the Sadducean priest who denigrated the water libation and was pelted with esrogim shows how kabbalas ol gives intellect its proper foundation and allows it to reach its full potential. Without the Beis Hamikdash and its sacrificial offerings, the mitzvah to rejoice physically on Yom Tov is fulfilled through drinking wine, including on Chol HaMoed. This class, taught by Rabbi Shais Taub, is based on Sukkos in Likkutei Sichos Vol. 2. 📄 PDF of Sicha: https://heyzine.com/flip-book/ad3ca1b... 📄 PDF of Sicha in English by SIE: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1p7J3... 📖 Buy Likkutei Sichos Vol. 2 at Kehot: https://store.kehotonline.com/prodinf.

latest.title: Likkutei Sichos: Haazinu
latest.blurb: When the Jewish people align their will with Hashem's will through good resolutions during the Ten Days of Repentance, heaven and earth yield to them so they can elevate abundant material blessings into spiritual purpose. By examining why Moshe and Yeshayahu used inverted expressions of closeness and distance when addressing heaven and earth, we see how true spiritual harmony requires mutual integration of transcendent holiness and practical action. Ani Ledodi 5746 אני לדודי תשמ"ו part 2/2 (end of Se'if 4-Se'if 8)
latest.blurb: Finishing the מאמר, the רבי answers the questions from סעיף ג, using the theme of the המלך בשדה as the "לב" of אלול to explain the connection of the אלול to פרשת ראה and to פרשת שופטים, while at the same time explaining why there is no פרשת שופטים in לקוטי תורה! The explanation is based on understanding the specialty of the "field" as it relates to the עבודה of אידן, and how that will be expressed when משיח comes.

latest.title: Ani Ledodi 5746 אני לדודי תשמ"ו part 1/2 (Se'if 1-4)
latest.blurb: In this powerful מאמר, the רבי focuses us on the point of the אלטער רבי's משל of המלך בשדה, highlighting the beautiful connection of Hashem and the אידן made available during the month of אלול. The רבי explains this with a wonderful דיוק of the fact that the משל is printed on דף ל"ב - heart - of לקוטי תורה חומש דברים: The "heart" of אלול is the beautiful connection of Hashem and the אידן as they become the heart of one another - and that is dependent on the אידן feeling this heartfelt connection with one another!

latest.title: Nosato Lirei'echo 5736 נתת ליראיך תשל"ו part 4/5 (Se'if 7-9)
latest.blurb: Continuing along the theme of ירידת הנשמה למטה, the רבי uses the rule of "כל הגבוה ביותר יורד למטה יותר" - whatever has a higher source falls lower - to demonstrate how a נסיון requires the most strength from the person to overcome: Being that in a נסיון, the sparks of קדושה are the most concealed, they are on the lowest level, thus showing on the power of their source, and the power of the נשמה of the איד necessary to use against the נסיון. To explain that, the רבי takes us through the עבודות of: fulfilling מצות עשה, pushing away לא תעשה, transforming לא תעשה, and ultimately נסיונות, ultimately showing us how נסיונות is incomparably different than עבודת הבירורים - even that of a לא תעשה.

latest.title: Nosato Lirei'echo 5736 נתת ליראיך תשל"ו part 3/5 (Se'if 5-6)
latest.blurb: Contrasting בירורים (even by מצות לא תעשה) with נסיונות, the רבי explains how נסיונות are not a true existence - as by the 'river' in the story of the עקידה - and that is how a איד passes tests - by remembering that they are only passing tests! This explains the עבודה of the פריערדיקער רבי in prison, making a firm resolution not to be intimidated by them - being that they are not a true existence. (See linked שיחה.) Continuing on into the main part of the מאמר, the רבי sets out to explain at length the difference between בירורים and נסיונות, beginning with the overall explanation of the reason for the נשמה's drastic descent into this world.

latest.title: Nosato Lirei'echo 5736 נתת ליראיך תשל"ו part 2/5 (Se'if 3-4)
latest.blurb: The רבי finishes the מאמר's opening part by showing how אברהם's עבודה of מסירות נפש came from his יחידה. This opens up the מאמר's discussion of the difference between the עבודה of בירורים and that of נסיונות: While בירורים means to work with the object, נסיונות is to distance oneself from it. Whereas בירורים is engagement with this world, נסיונות is the disengagement from it.
